documentation_excerpts.text: **Microsandbox** runs **untrusted workloads** inside fast, local microVMs: AI agents, user code, plugins, CI jobs, dev environments, scrapers, and automation.

- **Hardware Isolation**: Hardware-level isolation with tiny virtual machines. - **Fork & Snapshot**: Fork live sandboxes[^demo]. Save running sandbox state and restore later. - **Cross Platform**: Runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows. -
